description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Quantum Sky is hiring an early-career Software Engineer for Project 137, its applied research and intellectual property development initiative. The role develops, tests, and improves applications supporting AI-enabled workflows, network automation, and mission platforms using an AI-enabled software development lifecycle.
Software Engineer developing application features across backend services, APIs, and user interfaces with AI-assisted coding and testing

Responsibilities:
• Develop application features and resolve defects with guidance from experienced engineers
• Contribute to backend services, APIs, and user interfaces using technologies such as Python, Go, and JavaScript/TypeScript
• Work within an AI-enabled SDLC, using approved AI tools to support requirements analysis, design exploration, implementation, testing, code review, and documentation
• Use AI-assisted coding tools such as OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, and GitHub Copilot to develop, debug, refactor, and explain code
• Review and test AI-generated code for correctness, security, and maintainability, seeking guidance when needed and taking responsibility for submitted work
• Write and run tests, investigate unexpected behavior, and document findings
• Participate in code reviews, incorporate feedback, and explain development decisions
• Support prototypes and supervised development of AI-enabled application features
• Learn and follow the team’s version control, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), and deployment practices
• Apply secure coding practices and follow project requirements for using AI tools and handling information
• Communicate progress, questions, and blockers effectively in a remote team environment

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field
• Foundational understanding of programming, data structures, algorithms, and software design demonstrated through coursework, capstone projects, or personal projects
• Ability to write, understand, and explain code in at least one programming language
• Basic familiarity with software testing, debugging, and version control
• Willingness to learn and use AI-assisted coding tools throughout the software development lifecycle, including reviewing and validating generated outputs
• Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to follow through on assigned tasks
• Clear communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively, ask questions, and incorporate constructive feedback
• No prior professional software development experience required
• U.S. citizenship with the ability to obtain a security clearance

Preferred:
• Exposure to Python, Go, JavaScript, or TypeScript
• Familiarity with web application development, REST APIs, or relational databases
• Exposure to modern front-end frameworks such as React
• Experience using OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or comparable AI-assisted development tools in academic or personal projects
• Exposure to applications using large language models, AI agents, or automated workflows
• Familiarity with cloud services, containers, or automated build and deployment processes
• Academic, personal, or internship projects demonstrating an interest in software engineering, AI, or automation
